name: tt-tournoi
description: TT Tournoi — Plateforme de gestion de tournois de tennis de table (Chelles TT). Mono-repo Next.js 15 + Fastify WS + PostgreSQL + Redis.

scripts.env:sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env')){console.warn('Pas de .env racine'); process.exit(0);} ['packages/db','apps/web','apps/ws'].forEach(d=>{fs.copyFileSync('.env',d+'/.env'); console.log('Sync ->',d+'/.env');});"
scripts.db:generate: pnpm env:sync && pnpm --filter @tt/db exec prisma generate
scripts.db:push: pnpm env:sync && pnpm --filter @tt/db exec prisma db push --accept-data-loss
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm env:sync && pnpm --filter @tt/db exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: pnpm env:sync && pnpm --filter @tt/db exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: pnpm env:sync && pnpm --filter @tt/db exec tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:studio: pnpm env:sync && pnpm --filter @tt/db exec prisma studio
